name: JW Marriott Miami Turnberry Resort
insider_take: This isn't just another Miami resort – it's where championship golf meets Art Deco glamour in Aventura's most prestigious enclave.
whats_special: Home to the legendary Turnberry Isle Golf Course, this resort has hosted PGA Tour events and features two Robert Trent Jones Sr. championship courses. The property sits on a private island connected by bridges, offering exclusive access to both Biscayne Bay waterways and the renowned Aventura Mall – one of the largest shopping centers in the US.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view suite during sunset hours – the resort's unique island position offers unobstructed views of both the Intracoastal Waterway and downtown Miami skyline that most Miami hotels can't match.
dont_miss: The signature hole 18 overlooking the water, private yacht charters departing directly from the resort's marina, and the exclusive Bourbon Steak restaurant by celebrity chef Michael Mina – one of only a handful of locations worldwide.
pros: Championship golf course designed by Raymond Floyd
Luxurious spa with comprehensive wellness facilities
Multiple dining venues including fine dining options
Resort-style amenities with pools and recreational activities
cons: Premium pricing for luxury resort experience
